name_note: Most genomes GTDB places in this species are deposited in NCBI as [Ruminococcus] torques; the name Mediterraneibacter torques comes from a reclassification of that species.

sentences.text: Mediterraneibacter torques is a gut bacterium whose name comes from the reclassification of Ruminococcus torques into the genus Mediterraneibacter.
Counted as Ruminococcus torques, it belongs to the mucolytic bacteria characterised by the ability to degrade human secretory mucin, which a study reports are present in healthy humans.
That study reported Ruminococcus torques increased about 100-fold in macroscopically and histologically normal intestinal epithelium of both Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis patients.
A study of alcohol-related liver disease suggested Mediterraneibacter torques among microbes relevant for bile acid metabolism in patients.
